tier_rationale: Manufacturer owner's manual describes a corded 120V backpack vacuum whose only controls are a mechanical on/off switch on the waist belt and an internal thermal-overload cutoff. No wireless component, app, or connectivity feature is mentioned anywhere across the manual's setup, operation, or maintenance sections, and the design (a motor, a bag, a hose, a switch) has no function such a feature could serve.
the_unplug_test: Nothing changes, because there was never anything to unplug except the vacuum itself. It is a corded commercial backpack vacuum: plug it into a wall outlet, flip the belt-mounted switch, and clean. There is no battery to charge, no app to pair, and no account of any kind. The only automatic behaviour is a thermal cutoff that stops the motor if airflow is blocked, which resets itself once the unit cools.

repairability.notes: Sold through commercial janitorial-supply distributors with a published parts and filter reorder list (Intercept Micro Filter #107313, Micro Cloth Filter #834000, HEPA filter #107315). Filters are designed to be replaced by the owner on a weekly to monthly schedule per the manual.

sources.supports: Official ProTeam owner's manual (copyright ProTeam, Inc.) covering Super Coach Pro 10 (model 1073110), Super Coach Pro 6, and ProVac FS 6. Describes a 120V/60Hz corded motor with a thermal-protection cutoff, a belt-mounted mechanical on/off switch, and bag/filter maintenance. No WiFi, Bluetooth, app, or any connectivity feature appears anywhere in the setup, operating, or maintenance instructions across all three languages the manual is printed in.
Commercial janitorial-supply retailer listing corroborating current US availability of the Super Coach Pro 10 backpack vacuum and its price.

open_questions: No FCC grant search turned up any ProTeam/Emerson grantee filing at all, which is weaker evidence than a true sibling control (Speed Queen/Chamberlain-style) because ProTeam's entire commercial vacuum catalogue appears to be corded with no connected product line to compare against — there is no sibling grant to confirm the vendor files when it has a radio.
Confirm whether ProTeam's parent Emerson sells any connected/IoT-enabled commercial vacuum under a different product line that would change this assessment.
notes: A commercial janitorial backpack vacuum — the kind bought by contract cleaning crews for schools, offices, and convention centers. This buyer will not tolerate a vacuum that needs an app or a server; the entire category stays corded and mechanical for that reason.
